description: The agent must: 1) Read SKILL.md to understand the file-based architecture of the meal-suggester skill and locate the three key files: inventory/stock.md, inventory/history.md, and inventory/shopping-list.md. 2) Update inventory/stock.md by decrementing lardons from 200g to ~100g, chickpeas from 3 cans to 2 cans, and carrots from 4 to 3, and refresh the 'Last updated' date to 2025-02-10 or later. 3) Append a properly structured history entry in inventory/history.md under the heading '## 2025-02-10' matching the established format (Suggested, Cooked, Feedback, Would repeat, Ingredients used fields) including all three ingredients and a positive feedback sentiment. 4) Update inventory/shopping-list.md to include lardons and chickpeas in the 'Running Low' section (since lardons have now been used twice across two recent meals and chickpeas are being consumed regularly), and refresh the 'Last updated' date. The proprietary trap is the exact markdown structure of all three files — naive agents might write free-form text or miss the structured field format used in history.md, fail to track cumulative usage across history entries for the shopping list, or forget to update the Last updated timestamps.
